newsitem.title: USA: USDA lengthens GSM-102 credit list for Estonia.
newsitem.headline: USDA lengthens GSM-102 credit list for Estonia.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday it had expanded the list of commodities eligible to Estonia through the GSM-102 export credit program.
Estonia was offered $6 million in the short-term credits for fiscal 1997.
Newly eligible for the credits were:
--100 percent cotton fabric, including woven and knit unbleached, bleached, dyed and-or printed fabric.
--dried fruit, including apples, dates, figs, prunes and raisins.
--tree nuts, including almonds, pecans, pistachios, walnuts and hazelnuts.
